builds.name: Noxian Guillotine ceiling
builds.summary: Five Hemorrhage stacks double 375 + .75 AD[statFormula=2]. Noxian Might AD must be recorded at cast; armor penetration cannot amplify true ultimate damage.
builds.goal: Five Hemorrhage stacks double 375 + .75 AD[statFormula=2]. Noxian Might AD must be recorded at cast; armor penetration cannot amplify true ultimate damage.
builds.hypothesis:
Darius leaps to an enemy and strikes a lethal blow, dealing [125 / 250 / 375 + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2]] true damage. For each Hemorrhage on the target, this Ability deals an additional [20]% damage, up to a max of [(125 / 250 / 375 + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (2)] damage.

If this kills the target, Darius may Recast this Ability once within [20] seconds. At rank 3, this Ability has no Mana cost and kills refresh the Cooldown completely.
Bloodthirster/Eclipse supply AD; Sterak AD must be read live; Heartsteel/Titanic health feeds Bloodmail AD. No armor penetration is credited to true packets. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers. Override: Shadowflame replaces Eclipse because its explicit 20% amplification below 40% target HP supports true damage. Its AP and magic penetration do not increase the true packet coefficient (except Shyvana bite AP); compare retained Eclipse at 100% target HP. Low-HP rune candidate uses earned Conqueror adaptive stats and Last Stand instead of inactive Absolute Focus. Test rune eligibility separately; do not assume every amplifier affects true damage.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability max rank; minute 30, no external ally buffs or dragons, 3000 max-HP target with 1500 bonus HP, 100 armor/50 MR and 29% starting HP unless objective overrides. Heartsteel exactly 500 earned HP if present; self 10% HP for Bloodmail. Seraph earned from fully stacked Tear. Rune gathering time fixed at 30min; item combat ramps ready. Absolute Focus is inactive at this owner HP; do not retain its stat bonus. Loaded form: owner 10% HP, target 29% HP, Heartsteel earned HP 500, Rod stacks 0, prior champion combat 0s, Gathering Storm minute 30. Conqueror exactly 12 earned stacks prepared before the scored hit; observe Last Stand eligibility per damage packet, especially true damage.

Log raw kit packet(s), post-mitigation damage and separate item/rune packets; repeat at 100% target HP and swap one item at a time. First Strike must be ready and champion initiates; compare eligible bonus separately.

tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Bloodthirster, Sterak's Gage, Overlord's Bloodmail, Heartsteel, Titanic Hydra, Shadowflame. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Defensive or attack-speed replacements may win real fights despite a lower isolated packet.

Darius hefts his axe then swings it around, dealing [50 / 80 / 110 / 140 / 170 + ((100 / 110 / 120 / 130 / 140) × (0.01)) × AD] physical damage with the edge and [(50 / 80 / 110 / 140 / 170 + ((100 / 110 / 120 / 130 / 140) × (0.01)) × AD) × (0.35)] damage with the handle. Darius restores [17]% missing Health per enemy champion and large jungle monster hit with the edge, up to a max of [51]%.
